answer: Decaying identity bonds stop fake identities. Each agent posts one 50-unit bond locked for 20 epochs. It loses 5% each epoch unless the agent does verified work, such as certifying pigment or nectar goods, so idle clones drain away. Below 30 units it loses voting rights and its onyx seal lapses. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 units, more than their split rewards, while an honest agent pays once, stays alive, and earns undiluted rewards.
